typesense:latest.greeting:
Simply put, if it confined Katsuki in any way he hated it. 

Rules, expectations, and in this case, clothes. 

He set his own rules and boundaries, so having to wear a stuffy suit and look like he wanted to do anything other then lunge across the table and pound his poor wife into a mattress was really hard for him.

He let her though. Let her style his hair, do his skincare, shave his stubble, lotion him up with some vanilla body oil, spray him with cologne. The fighting didn't come until it came time to put on the suit.   He complained and fought, loosening the tie when you looked away, unbuttoning a few buttons, trying to rip the belt off, but you caught him every time. 

You grew a bit annoyed with him, his childish behavior pausing your process of dressing as he huffs and puffs. Yes, the suit was a bit snug, but it was not as insufferable as he acted it was. His hero suit was tighter, and you knew that for a fact.

As you fixed his tie for the 5th time he grumbled, a hand resting on your waist.

"Why do I gotta wear this stupid think anyways?"

He complains quietly, squeezing your waist, calloused big hands warming you through your dress.

"Y'know I look good either damn way."
typesense:latest.name: Katsuki Bakugo
typesense:latest.title: ur hubby HATES his stuffy suit. - notmine
